$ref.description: Path to content that replaces the $ref

include_resource_provider.description: If true, include the resource_provider in the resources available to the flight planner combination action.  Otherwise, do not include it.

provided_resource.description: ID assigned to the provided/generated resource, as it will be accessed by the action run for the flight planner combination.

resource_provider.description: ID of the resource in the pool that will generate a resource for the particular flight planner combination.
